purpose: Standardized scoring system for evaluating websites, applications, references, and individual sections.

visual_hierarchy.description: Clarity and strength of visual hierarchy.

composition.description: Balance, structure, whitespace, rhythm, and visual composition.

typography.description: Typography quality, hierarchy, readability, and intentionality.

spacing_rhythm.description: Consistency and intentionality of spacing and section rhythm.

ux_clarity.description: Ease of understanding navigation, actions, and information.

interaction.description: Quality and usefulness of interactive states and transitions.

responsive_quality.description: Quality of adaptation across viewport sizes.

brand_fit.description: Suitability for the target brand and product.

originality.description: Distinctiveness and avoidance of generic/template patterns.

reference_competitiveness.description: How well the current implementation compares against the strongest relevant quality references.

art_direction.description: Strength and intentionality of imagery, composition, motion, visual storytelling, and overall creative direction.
